name: Osteria
description: Chef Jeff Michaud channels seasonal northern Italian cooking into wood-fired dishes and handmade pastas at this longtime North Broad standout. A 300-bottle Italian wine cellar and daily happy hour make it as suited to a splurge as to a casual glass at the bar.

name: A Mano
description: Townsend Wentz's intimate BYOB builds its prix-fixe menus around handmade pasta and family-style comfort classics. It is a reliable choice for a warm, unhurried dinner with a group, where each person picks a dish per course.

name: Umai Umai
description: This cozy BYOB sushi spot turns out inventive specialty rolls alongside fresh nigiri and Japanese small plates. Its creative, flavor-forward approach has made it a Fairmount favorite for date nights and special occasions.

name: Zorba's Tavern
description: A decades-old neighborhood institution serving traditional Greek plates from gyros and hummus to shared roasts. The white-tablecloth room works equally well for a casual midday meal or a relaxed dinner over a bottle of red.

name: Bad Brother
description: An ambitious gastropub where regulars gather over sausage rolls, house cheeseburgers, and a rotation of nightly specials. The wide-ranging drink list spans cider, mead, wine, and cocktails, including non-alcoholic options.

name: Jack's Firehouse
description: A farm-to-table mainstay of more than 35 years, serving scratch-made American fare across brunch, lunch, and dinner. Steaks, fish, and St. Louis-cut ribs anchor a menu paired with a pleasant open-air bar.

name: Bar Hygge
description: Named for the Danish idea of coziness, this warm brewpub pours house-brewed beers in a living-room-like setting. The menu leans on elevated bar classics and customizable snacking boards meant for lingering.

name: South Jazz Kitchen
description: A supper club pairing well-executed Southern cooking with live jazz performances on North Broad. Ticketed shows and classic cocktails like the Sazerac make it a destination for dinner and music together.

name: La Calaca Feliz
description: A bright, festive spot bringing Mexican flavors and an extensive tequila list to Fairmount Avenue. Fish tacos and tortilla soup headline a menu that fills a gap in the neighborhood's dining scene.

name: Figs
description: A cash-only, BYOB neighborhood favorite with a Mediterranean menu shaped by Moroccan influences. Longtime regulars prize its brunch, where Moroccan eggs in spicy tomato sauce share the table with buttermilk pancakes.
